config.name: container
config.description: The element the canvas fills. Size it with CSS; the globe follows it.

config.name: mode
config.description: Scene projection. Only `'sphere'` renders today; `'flat'` is reserved for a future map view. Default `'sphere'`.

config.name: kind
config.description: Visual identity of the rendered globe. Each kind owns its renderer pipeline + per-kind tokens + per-kind config. Defaults to the kind registered for the active theme preset (`outline-*` → `'outline'`, `'dotted-dark'` → `'dotted'`, `'wireframe-tron'` → `'wireframe'`), falling back to `'outline'` for custom themes.

config.name: theme
config.description: A built-in or registered preset name, or `{ extends, tokens }` to override individual tokens on top of a preset. Defaults to the active kind's first preset.

config.name: countries
config.description: Country geometry resolution, hover behaviour and per-instance border and fill styling.

children.name: resolution
children.description: Which country geometry loads: `'low'` (about 90 kB), `'medium'` or `'high'`. Default `'medium'`.

children.name: hoverEnabled
children.description: Pick and highlight the country under the pointer. Default true.

children.name: hoverOccludeBackSide
children.description: When true (default), the hover highlight respects the globe's depth — the back-side portions of a country (e.g. the part wrapped around the far side) are hidden. Set to false for an "x-ray" feel where the entire country outline is always visible.

children.name: borderHover
children.description: Per-instance overrides for the hovered country's stroke + additive glow halo. Each field is independent — set what you want to change, leave the rest. Empty-string color / non-positive numeric = "use theme token" sentinel (matches the pattern used elsewhere).

children.name: borderActive
children.description: Per-instance overrides for the pinned/active country's stroke. Same sentinel semantics as `borderHover`.

children.name: fill
children.description:
Country fill layer config. Independent of strokes — paints the country shape with a solid color.

Modes:
- `'none'` — layer hidden (default; matches the legacy "wait for setData / setDataLayer choropleth" behaviour).
- `'always'` — every country shown with `defaultColor` × `defaultOpacity`.
- `'palette'` — every country picks `palette[index % palette.length]` (stable order from the loaded features array).
- `'data'` — driven by `setData(map, scale?)` / choropleth data layer.

State overrides recolor a single country in place; active wins over hover when both target the same country.

children.name: hoverColor
children.description: Empty string / non-positive numeric = no override (layer falls back to base).

config.name: countryLabels
config.description: Country name labels rendered as HTML overlays at each country's centroid. Hidden by default — enable explicitly. Small countries fade out when zoomed out (`minScreenSize`); labels on the far side of the globe fade via the same occlusion smoothstep as HTML markers.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Show the labels. Default false.

children.name: color
children.description: Override the theme-driven label text color. CSS-style hex / rgb / rgba string. Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.color']`.

children.name: fontSize
children.description: Override the theme-driven font size (CSS pixels). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontSize']`.

children.name: fontWeight
children.description: Override the theme-driven font weight (e.g. `'500'`, `'700'`, `'bold'`). Falls back to `tokens['countries.label.fontWeight']`.

children.name: labels
children.description: Per-id override map; missing ids fall back to the source `feature.name`.

children.name: minScreenSize
children.description: Minimum apparent screen-pixel size of a country before its label appears. Higher = stricter (fewer labels at any given zoom). Default 60.

children.name: sizeFadeRange
children.description: Width of the smoothstep band (as a fraction of `minScreenSize`) over which the label fades from invisible to fully visible. 0 = hard cutoff, 1 = fades start at zero size. Default 0.4 (label is fully on by `minScreenSize`, fully off below `minScreenSize * 0.6`).

children.name: occlusionFade
children.description: Occlusion smoothstep edges (`facing` = dot product of country normal with camera direction). Defaults `[-0.05, 0.15]` — labels remain visible just past the silhouette and fade in fully once the country has rotated a hair toward the camera. Pass `[0, 0]` for a hard cutoff at the silhouette.

children.name: transitionMs
children.description: Fade-in / fade-out duration in milliseconds, applied as a CSS `transition: opacity Xms ease-out`. Default 200. Set to 0 to snap.

children.name: halo
children.description: Optional CSS halo around each label (a thicker, blurred outline that keeps the text legible against any base color). Drawn via stacked `text-shadow` calls so it works without a canvas pass. When provided, **replaces** the theme `countries.label.textShadow` token.

children.name: radius
children.description: Halo radius in CSS pixels. Default 2.

children.name: steps
children.description: Number of stacked shadow copies (more = denser halo). Default 4.

children.name: padding
children.description: Inner padding applied to each label element in CSS pixels — useful when you want a larger hit-test area, breathing room behind a halo, or to offset the label from a halo background. Default 0.

config.name: countryData
config.description: Initial per-country colours and values, keyed by zero-padded ISO 3166-1 numeric id. Same shape as `setCountryData()`.

config.name: markers
config.description: Initial pins. Replace or edit later with `setMarkers()`, `addMarker()` and `removeMarker()`.

config.name: htmlMarkers
config.description: Initial DOM-anchored markers.

config.name: arcs
config.description: Initial great-circle connections.

config.name: atmosphere
config.description: The Fresnel rim glow. Rendered unless `enabled` is `false`.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Render the rim glow. Default true.

children.name: color
children.description: Override the theme-driven Fresnel halo color. Any CSS-style hex / rgb / rgba string. Falls back to `tokens['atmosphere.color']`.

children.name: intensity
children.description: Override the theme-driven halo intensity multiplier. 0 = invisible (same as `enabled: false` but keeps the layer mounted); 1 = theme default; higher values brighten / widen the rim. Falls back to `tokens['atmosphere.intensity']`.

children.name: radiusScale
children.description: Mesh radius as a multiplier of `GLOBE_RADIUS`. Range 1.01..1.5 — tight rim ↔ wide aurora. Default 1.15.

children.name: power
children.description: Fresnel exponent. 0.5 = soft / diffuse glow filling most of the silhouette; 4.0 = razor-thin rim hugging the edge. Default 2.0.

children.name: threshold
children.description: Fresnel threshold (where the rim starts). 0 = entire sphere shows tint; 1 = only the silhouette edge. Default 0.6.

children.name: side
children.description: Render side. `'back'` (default) draws on the inside of the surrounding shell so it reads as a halo behind the globe. `'front'` drops the rim onto the front-facing portion (haze over the planet); `'double'` does both for a heavier atmosphere.

children.name: blending
children.description: Blend mode. `'additive'` (default) reads as glow on dark themes; `'normal'` is a flat overlay that avoids highlight blowouts on cream / paper themes.

children.name: pulse
children.description: Optional time-driven brightness oscillation (atmospheric "breath").

children.name: speed
children.description: Frequency in Hz. Default 0.25 (slow).

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Amplitude as a fraction of base intensity. Default 0.25.

config.name: focusPulse
config.description:
Cross-kind behaviour for the focus-pulse decoration. Visual style still comes from each kind's `focusPulse` decorator (see `kinds/shared/focus- pulse-decorators.ts`); this section governs *when* and *where* the pulse fires regardless of kind.

- `origin` — `'centroid'` (default) fires from the focused country's centroid via `globe.focusOnCountry()`. `'click'` instead uses the exact lat/lng the user just clicked, falling back to the centroid if no recent click was recorded.
- `pulseOnSurfaceClick` — when true, additionally fire a pulse on *any* surface click that doesn't land on a country (e.g. clicks on ocean / wireframe void). Default false.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Master enable. When false, no kind spawns its pulse decorator. Default true.

config.name: outline
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'outline'`.

children.name: hover
children.description:
Hover-stroke geometry knobs specific to outline. Outline is pure linework so the default "lift the highlight a hair above the base border" trick other kinds use produces a visible duplicate-stroke ghost. These knobs let callers tune (or zero out) the lift to taste.

- `lift` — multiplier added to the surface radius for the *crisp* highlight stroke (the recoloured border). 0 (default) means draw at the same radius as the base border, so the highlight just recolors the existing line. Values like 0.0025 reproduce the legacy lifted look used by other kinds.
- `glowLift` — multiplier for the additive halo behind the highlight. Default 0.0035 — keeps the soft aura noticeably above the surface without competing with the crisp stroke.

Both are *relative to* the globe radius, so 0.001 = 0.1% above surface.

children.name: focusPulse
children.description: Sci-fi sonar pulse fired from a focused country's centroid (or click point, depending on `focusPulse.origin` at the top level). Outline's defaults produce a crisp gold ring with quadratic fade — knobs let callers thicken / slow / brighten it without re-styling the whole preset.

children.name: angularRadiusBase
children.description: Ring radius at scale=1 in radians on the sphere. Default 0.06 (~3.4°).

children.name: angularBand
children.description: Band thickness in radians. Default 0.013 (~0.7°).

children.name: scaleMin
children.description: Linear scale of the ring at t=0. Default 0.4.

children.name: scaleMax
children.description: Linear scale of the ring at t=1 (peak expansion). Default 2.5.

children.name: peakOpacity
children.description: Initial alpha at t=0. Default 1.0.

children.name: segments
children.description: Polygon resolution around the ring. Default 96.

children.name: radiusFactor
children.description: Lift above the globe surface as a multiplier of GLOBE_RADIUS. Default 1.0045.

children.name: color
children.description: Reticle line color override. Falls back to `tokens['countries.borderHover.color']`.

children.name: size
children.description: Reticle size as world units on the sphere. Default 0.012.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Material opacity (0..1). Default 0.85.

children.name: ringRadiusFactor
children.description: Inner ring radius as a fraction of the cross arm length. 0 = no ring, 0.7 (default) = ring fits inside the cross diagonal.

children.name: cardinalTicks
children.description: Show small N/S/E/W ticks just outside the ring. Default true.

children.name: tooltip
children.description: Show the DOM lat/lng readout near the cursor. Default true.

children.name: tooltipDecimals
children.description: Decimals in the lat/lng readout. Default 2.

config.name: cinematic
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'cinematic'`.

children.name: cloudOpacity
children.deprecated: Clouds moved to a separate shell — use `clouds.opacity`. Only honoured at construction as a fallback for the shell's opacity.

children.name: relief
children.description: Terrain relief / normal-perturbation strength 0..2. Default 1.

children.name: biomes
children.description: Latitude / altitude / moisture driven land palette. Default true.

children.name: shallows
children.description: Turquoise shallows + beaches strength 0..1. Default 0.6.

children.name: moonlight
children.description: Night-side moonlight strength 0..2. Default 1.

children.name: snowLine
children.description: Height above which land turns to snow, 0..1. Default 0.72.

children.name: saturation
children.description: Surface colour saturation multiplier: 1 natural, 0 monochrome. Default from the theme.

children.name: sun
children.description:
Sun / light rig for the cinematic kind.

- `fixed` (default) — the light direction is a constant world-space vector (`direction`, falling back to `surface.lightDirection` and then the theme tokens). Auto-rotate orbits the camera, so the lit side stays put in the world.
- `realtime` — the subsolar point is computed from `date` (default: now) and advances with wall-clock time × `timeScale`. Produces the real day/night terminator for that moment.
- `orbit` — time-lapse: the subsolar longitude sweeps westward at `speed` degrees per second (default 6 → one full day every 60 s).

`visible` draws a sun disc + glare far along the light direction (it blooms when it clears the limb).

children.name: clouds
children.description: Procedural (or textured) cloud shell above the surface.

children.name: coverage
children.description: 0..1 fraction of sky covered. Default 0.48.

children.name: opacity
children.description: 0..1 peak opacity. Default 0.85.

children.name: speed
children.description: Advection speed multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: altitude
children.description: Shell height as a fraction of the globe radius. Default 0.009.

children.name: shadows
children.description: Project cloud shadows onto the surface. Default true.

children.name: shadowStrength
children.description: 0..1 darkening under clouds. Default 0.55.

children.name: softness
children.description: Edge softness 0..1. Default 0.5.

children.name: aurora
children.description: Night-side auroral curtains near the geomagnetic poles.

children.name: intensity
children.description: 0..2. Default 0.8.

children.name: speed
children.description: Curtain animation speed multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: latitude
children.description: Centre latitude of the auroral oval in degrees. Default 68.

children.name: textures
children.description: Optional real Earth textures. Any subset works — the procedural look fills in whatever is missing. Strings are URLs loaded with three's `TextureLoader`; `Texture` instances are used as-is.

children.name: anisotropy
children.description: Anisotropic filtering level. Default 8 (clamped to device max).

children.name: fadeMs
children.description: Crossfade from procedural → textured in ms. Default 800.

children.name: atmosphere
children.description: Scattering-shell atmosphere tuning (cinematic-only, on top of `GlobeConfig.atmosphere`).

children.name: scatterStrength
children.description: Rayleigh strength multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: mieStrength
children.description: Mie (forward-scatter halo) strength multiplier. Default 1.

children.name: airglow
children.description: Faint night-side limb glow 0..1. Default 0.18.

children.name: thickness
children.description: Shell thickness as a fraction of the globe radius. Default 0.075.

config.name: dotted
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'dotted'`.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use base dot color brightened.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the white-default flash color from tokens.

children.name: drift
children.description: Ambient drift wave — `sin(dot(position, axis) * freq - elapsed * speed)` added to per-dot brightness, very small amplitude so it feels like the globe is breathing rather than strobing. Default-on.

children.name: axis
children.description: `'ns'` = north-south wave (drift along Y axis); `'ew'` = east-west; `'both'` = a diagonal axis that mixes the two for moiré-like patterns.

children.name: perCountryPhase
children.description: When true (default), each country's drift wave is rotated by a deterministic hash of its index so adjacent countries breathe at slightly different times rather than strobing in unison. The dotted-only "every country has its own pulse" personality.

children.name: hoverDots
children.description: Hover dot expansion — when a country is hovered, its dots scale up and brighten, easing in/out smoothly. Default-on.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS` — pushes the hovered country's dots outward along the surface normal so the country reads as "rising out of the field" toward the camera. Default 0.008 (≈0.8%). Set to 0 for a hover-without-lift look.

children.name: activeCountry
children.description: Pinned-country pulse — the dotted analogue of the standard `SelectionLayer` active stroke (which dotted opts out of). When `globe.setActiveCountry(id)` runs, the pinned country's dots pick up a steady brightness boost + slow sine pulse. Independent from hover so the user can pin one country and hover another.

children.name: boost
children.description: Steady brightness boost added to active dots. Default 0.65.

children.name: scale
children.description: Active-country dot scale multiplier. Default 1.18.

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Sine pulse frequency in Hz. Default 0.65.

children.name: lift
children.description: Radial lift as a fraction of `GLOBE_RADIUS`. Same idea as the hover lift but with a higher default so pinned reads stronger. Default 0.012 (≈1.2%).

children.name: edge
children.description:
Country-edge highlight — extra brightness + radial lift applied only to the surface dots that already sit at the country's silhouette (`aIsEdge` per dot, baked at build time). Replaces the old `borderDots` separate-layer approach: instead of emitting a second dot string at sub-degree spacing (which fights the surface grid and reads as misaligned noise), we just brighten the existing grid dots that trace the boundary.

Active only on the hovered/pinned country — interior dots and non-active countries are unaffected.

children.name: enabled
children.description: Master toggle. False zeroes both `boost` and `lift`. Default true.

children.name: boost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added to edge-dots on hover/active. 0 = no rim, just the standard country brightness. Default 0.55.

children.name: lift
children.description: Extra radial lift applied only to edge-dots on hover/active, stacked on top of `hoverDots.lift` / `activeCountry.lift`. Fraction of GLOBE_RADIUS. Default 0.004.

children.name: appearance
children.description: Master appearance overrides applied to every dot. Lets callers recolor / resize the entire field without theming, while still letting per-effect colors mix on top.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use theme `countries.dotted.color`.

children.name: sizeScale
children.description: Multiplier on the theme size; 1 = no change, 0 collapses to theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Master opacity; ≤0 = use theme `countries.dotted.opacity`.

children.name: dots
children.description:
Per-country dot colour overrides — independent of the country fill mesh that sits *behind* the dots (configured via `countries.fill`). Modes mirror the fill layer so the user can tint dots with a palette, drive them from data, or apply hover/active colour overrides without touching the background.

- `'theme'` (default) — every dot uses `countries.dotted.color`.
- `'palette'` — each country picks a colour from `palette` by feature index modulo, recoloured per-vertex.
- `'data'` — palette index resolved from a data map (see `countries.fill` doc — same shape, runs through choropleth flow if you also drive fill from data).

Hover / active overrides apply on top of whichever base the mode produced; active wins over hover when both target the same country. Empty-string colour is the universal "no override" sentinel matching the rest of the configurator.

children.name: cursorWake
children.description: Cursor wake — small ripple that fades behind the cursor as it moves across the globe surface. Lower-amplitude than clickRipple, so it reads as ambient response rather than impact.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier at the wake's center. Default 0.6.

children.name: fade
children.description: Fade-out duration in seconds. Default 0.45.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.09.

children.name: latitudeBands
children.description: Geographic latitude emphasis — equator + tropics get a brightness boost so the dot grid implicitly draws the planet's main parallels. Subtle (low boost) by default; crank it up for atlas-like clarity.

children.name: equatorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added at the equator (lat = 0). Default 0.35.

children.name: tropicsBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier added at the tropics (lat ≈ ±23.5°). Default 0.18.

children.name: width
children.description: Half-width of each band in degrees of latitude. Default 4.

children.name: pulseBreath
children.description: Whole-field "breath" — global brightness oscillation, like the atmosphere's pulse but on the dots themselves.

children.name: amplitude
children.description: Brightness amplitude (0..1). Default 0.12.

children.name: speed
children.description: Cycles per second. Default 0.35.

children.name: constellation
children.description: Constellation lines — when a country is hovered, draw thin glowing lines connecting nearest-neighbour dots within the country, treating the dot grid as a star chart.

children.name: color
children.description: Empty string = use the base dot color.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Line opacity (0..1). Default 0.55.

children.name: distanceFactor
children.description: Multiplier on the minimum spacing between adjacent dots; lines are drawn between any pair within this many "grid steps" of each other. Default 1.6 — connects each dot to its ring of neighbours.

config.name: wireframe
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'wireframe'`.

children.name: density
children.description: Override token-driven density (1 = default, lower = sparser).

children.name: pulse
children.description: Override token-driven pulse amplitude (0..1, 0 = disabled).

children.name: color
children.description: Override the base grid line color. Empty string = use theme token. The pulse / boost colors layered on top read from `clickPulse.color` and `gridPulse.color` independently.

children.name: opacity
children.description: 0..1 base opacity — non-positive resets to theme.

children.name: hierarchy
children.description: Major / minor line distinction — primary parallels + meridians (every `majorStepDeg` degrees) render at `majorBoost` * base brightness so the grid reads as a hierarchy, not a uniform mesh. Defaults: stepDeg=30, majorBoost=1.6, minorBoost=0.85, edge thickness handled by the renderer.

children.name: majorStepDeg
children.description: Spacing of "major" lines in degrees. Default 30.

children.name: majorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier for major lines. Default 1.6.

children.name: minorBoost
children.description: Brightness multiplier for non-major (minor) lines. Default 0.85.

children.name: clickPulse
children.description: Click pulse — radial brightness wave expanding along the grid from any surface click. Tron-style impact feedback.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront expansion in radians/sec. Default 1.5.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.18.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier at the wavefront. Default 2.5.

children.name: maxConcurrent
children.description: Maximum simultaneous click pulses (older ones recycle). Default 4.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: emphasis
children.description: Geographic emphasis — equator + tropics get 2× brightness; prime meridian + antimeridian get half emphasis. Subtle visual hierarchy.

children.name: strongColor
children.description: Override the strong (equator + tropics) line color. Empty = theme.

children.name: weakColor
children.description: Override the weak (meridians) line color. Empty = theme.

children.name: strongOpacity
children.description: Strong-line opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: weakOpacityFactor
children.description: Weak-line opacity factor (0..1). Default 0.5.

children.name: equatorBeam
children.description: Equator beam — a thicker glowing line at the equator drawn separately from `emphasis`. Reads as a "data spine" running around the planet, can be pulsed for that "live energy" feel.

children.name: color
children.description: Override beam color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Beam opacity (0..1). Non-positive = default 0.85.

children.name: pulse
children.description: Pulse the beam intensity over time. Default false.

children.name: pulseSpeed
children.description: Beam pulse Hz when `pulse` enabled. Default 0.6.

children.name: glitch
children.description: CRT-glitch transients — every interval seconds, a horizontal band briefly shears laterally then snaps back. Atmosphere, not noise.

children.name: intervalMin
children.description: Lower bound of inter-glitch wait (seconds). Default 5.

children.name: intervalMax
children.description: Upper bound of inter-glitch wait (seconds). Default 15.

children.name: activeRing
children.description: Glowing ring around the centroid of the currently active (pinned) country. Sized to enclose the country's main ring with `padding` margin; rotates slowly around its outward axis. Fades in/out on activate/clear.

children.name: rotationSpeed
children.description: Rotation around the outward axis (rad/sec). Default 0.5.

children.name: padding
children.description: Multiplier on the country's angular radius. Default 1.2.

children.name: color
children.description: Override ring color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Ring opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: poleStreams
children.description: Distant data-flow streams — small luminous particles continuously falling from the north pole towards the south pole along random meridians.

children.name: count
children.description: Number of simultaneously-active particles. Default 16.

children.name: speed
children.description: Southward angular velocity in radians/sec. Default 0.6.

children.name: color
children.description: Override stream color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: size
children.description: Particle size. Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Stream opacity (0..1). Non-positive = theme default.

children.name: dataPackets
children.description: Data packets — small luminous "blips" that race along latitude / longitude lines as if information was being carried through the grid. Each packet has a short fading trail.

children.name: count
children.description: Total simultaneous packets. Default 24.

children.name: speed
children.description: Travel speed in radians/sec. Default 0.9.

children.name: trail
children.description: Trail length in radians (0 = no trail). Default 0.18.

children.name: size
children.description: Packet point size. Default 0.018.

children.name: color
children.description: Override packet color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: axis
children.description: Which axis the packets travel along. Default `'both'`.

children.name: compass
children.description: Compass markers — N/S/E/W cardinal letters anchored above the surface at the four cardinal poles (and the two geographic poles). Acts as a "we know where we are" anchor for the viewer.

children.name: color
children.description: Override marker color. Empty string = theme default.

children.name: size
children.description: Marker text size in pixels. Default 12.

children.name: opacity
children.description: Opacity (0..1). Non-positive = default 0.9.

children.name: poles
children.description: Show N + S poles in addition to cardinals. Default true.

children.name: gridPulse
children.description: Autonomous grid pulse — like the click pulse, but fires periodically from either a fixed location or a random origin each cycle. Reads as the grid "breathing" or "transmitting" without needing user input.

children.name: intervalSec
children.description: Seconds between pulses. Default 4.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront speed (rad/sec). Default 1.2.

children.name: width
children.description: Gaussian band half-width in radians. Default 0.16.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier. Default 1.8.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color (empty = uses click-pulse color).

children.name: mode
children.description: `'fixed'` = always from `origin` lat/lng; `'random'` = random sphere point each cycle.

children.name: originLat
children.description: Origin lat (used when `mode === 'fixed'`). Default 0.

children.name: originLng
children.description: Origin lng (used when `mode === 'fixed'`). Default 0.

children.name: polePulse
children.description: Pole pulses — periodic radial waves emanating outward from the geographic poles. Distinct from `poleStreams` (which travel pole→pole along meridians); pole pulses spread around the cap as a halo.

children.name: intervalSec
children.description: Seconds between pulses. Default 5.

children.name: speed
children.description: Wavefront speed in rad/sec. Default 1.0.

children.name: boost
children.description: Peak brightness multiplier. Default 1.5.

children.name: color
children.description: Override pulse color. Empty string = theme default (uses pulse color).

children.name: which
children.description: Which pole(s) to fire from. Default `'both'`.

config.name: paper
config.description: Options read only when `kind` is `'paper'`.

children.name: fiberAmount
children.description: Long paper-fiber strokes baked into the parchment texture (0..1).

children.name: stainAmount
children.description: Watercolor / age-stain wash intensity baked into the texture (0..1).

children.name: washColor
children.description: Tint used for the watercolor/stain wash. Empty string = default.

children.name: waterLineAmount
children.description: Wavy engraved ocean hatch intensity (0..1).

children.name: waterLineColor
children.description: Ink color for the ocean hatch. Empty string = default.

children.name: density
children.description: Average dot every N world-units along the ring. Lower = denser.

children.description: Delay in ms between scene enter and the camera transition starting. Useful for letting a popup appear before the camera moves. Default 0.

children.name: transitionElevation
children.description: Extra camera radius peaking at the midpoint of the transition. Creates a "fly-over arc" — pulls the camera up and back down for a cinematic feel on long jumps. Default 0 (straight slerp).

children.name: easing
children.description: Easing for the camera transition. Accepts a function or a CSS-like name (`'linear'`, `'easeIn'`, `'easeOut'`, `'easeInOut'`). Default `'easeInOut'`.

children.name: autoRotate
children.description: If set, toggle auto-rotate while this scene is active. Restored on the next scene that specifies it (otherwise stays as last set). Useful for "intro spinning earth" scenes paired with stationary detail scenes.

children.name: flyTo
children.description: Fly the camera to a lat/lng. Mutually exclusive with `focusOnCountry` — if both are provided, `focusOnCountry` wins.

children.name: focusOnCountry
children.description: Auto-frame a country (uses bbox-derived distance). Pass a string for default behaviour, or an object to override padding (smaller padding = more zoomed-in arrival).

children.name: activeCountry
children.description: Active country to highlight throughout this scene. Pass `null` to explicitly clear; omit to inherit from the previous scene.

children.name: popup
children.description: Optional HTML popup anchored to a position; auto-removed on scene exit.

children.name: autoPlay
children.description: Begin auto-advancing on `setStory()`. Default false.

children.name: loop
children.description: Restart from scene 0 after the last scene completes. Default false.

children.name: startAt
children.description: Scene id to start at. Defaults to first scene.

members.name: duration
members.description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default 1500.

members.name: easing
members.description: Easing function. Default `easeInOutCubic`.

members.name: elevation
members.description: Extra camera radius added during the flight, peaking at the midpoint (sin(t·π) profile). Creates a "fly-over" arc that pulls the camera up and back down — feels more cinematic than a straight slerp, especially for long jumps. Default 0.

members.name: padding
members.description: Fraction of the viewport to leave as padding around the focused country, 0..0.5. 0.15 means ~15% of the viewport edge is empty space. Default 0.15.

members.name: pauseAutoRotateOnFocus
members.description: If true (default), auto-rotation is disabled when the focus animation starts — natural for "I'm clicking to inspect this country, stop spinning". Set to false to keep rotating after focus completes.

members.name: center
members.description: Override the camera target lat/lng. Defaults to the country's centroid (computed from its main-ring bounds). Useful for "direct-focus" — click on Russia, fly toward the exact spot you clicked while still framing the whole country at the right zoom.
members.default: the country's centroid (computed from its main-ring bounds)

members.name: domain
members.description: [min, max] of the input value range. Defaults to data extent.

members.name: noDataColor
members.description: Color used for entries with no value or value outside domain.

members.name: palette
members.description: Two-color or three-color palette. Defaults to RdBu.

members.name: domain
members.description: [min, midpoint, max]. Defaults to [-extent, 0, +extent].

members.name: thresholds
members.description: Sorted ascending. N thresholds → N+1 buckets.

members.name: colors
members.description: N+1 colors, one per bucket.

members.name: colors
members.description: Map from category value → color.

ScalePalette.name: ScalePalette
ScalePalette.description: Custom palette: ordered list of color stops, evenly distributed across t∈[0,1].

ScalePaletteName.name: ScalePaletteName
ScalePaletteName.description: Color scales for choropleth-style country data binding. Built-in palettes are defined as small endpoint stops; `interpolatePalette` does linear RGB interpolation between them. Good enough visually for dataviz; for very faithful color science you'd reach for d3-scale-chromatic, but we want zero runtime deps.

members.name: format
members.description: Format raw domain values into tick labels. Default `String(v)`. Useful for unit suffixes (`v => v + ' M'`) or rounding.

members.name: tickCount
members.description: Number of ticks for sequential / diverging scales. Default 5.

members.name: width
members.description: Width of the gradient bar in pixels. Default 200.

members.name: position
members.description: Where to anchor the legend inside the host. Default 'bottom-left'.

members.name: style
members.description: Style overrides — usually fed from the resolved theme so the legend matches the rest of the HUD. Falls back to a dark-tooltip-ish default.

ThemeConfig.name: ThemeConfig
ThemeConfig.description: User-supplied theme config. `extends` selects a built-in preset (autocompletes) OR a custom preset registered via `registerThemePreset()`; `tokens` overrides individual values on top of that floor.

ThemeInput.name: ThemeInput
ThemeInput.description: Public theme entry point. Accepts either a preset name (shorthand) — built-in or custom — or a full ThemeConfig object.

ThemePresetName.name: ThemePresetName
ThemePresetName.description:
Names of built-in theme presets.

Naming convention: `<kind>-<flavour>`. The `<kind>` prefix maps to the default globe kind via `kinds/registry.ts → PRESET_DEFAULT_KIND`, so a user picking `'dotted-dark'` gets the dotted kind automatically.

EasingFunction.name: EasingFunction
EasingFunction.description: Easing function — receives normalized progress t∈[0,1], returns eased t∈[0,1].

EasingName.name: EasingName
EasingName.description: CSS-like named easings. Resolved to functions by `resolveEasing`.

ZoomMode.name: ZoomMode
ZoomMode.description:
Zoom interaction mode.

- `classic`: scroll changes camera distance only; angles unchanged.
- `repel`: each scroll step rotates the camera so the world point under the cursor stays under the cursor — the cursor "anchors" to that point.
- `attract`: each scroll step rotates the camera to pull the world point under the cursor toward the center of the screen.

GlobeKind.name: GlobeKind
GlobeKind.description:
Globe kinds — the high-level visual identity of the rendered globe. Each kind owns its renderer pipeline + per-kind tokens + per-kind config.

- `outline` — vector country borders on a solid sphere (default)
- `dotted` — Apple/Stripe-style: glowing dots fill each country, no borders
- `wireframe` — Tron-style: pure lat/lng grid, no country geometry
- `hologram` — sci-fi command-deck: transparent shell, scanlines, Fresnel rim
- `cinematic` — marketing/night-earth: physically lit ocean, city lights, luminous borders and data-network overlays

Future kinds: `paper`, `choropleth`. New kinds get a `kinds/<name>/` folder with their own layer + index.ts exporting a `KindModule`, then a registry entry in `kinds/registry.ts`.

DataLayer.name: DataLayer
DataLayer.type: | ChoroplethDataLayer | BarsDataLayer | ExtrudedDataLayer | HeatmapDataLayer | HexBinDataLayer | ChartsDataLayer

ChoroplethDataLayer.name: ChoroplethDataLayer
ChoroplethDataLayer.description: Per-country values driving choropleth (a dataset keyed by ISO id). 2D fill — colours each country by its scale-mapped value.

members.name: events
members.type: DataLayerEvents<{ readonly id: string; readonly value?: number }>

BarsDataLayer.name: BarsDataLayer
BarsDataLayer.description: Bars rising from the sphere surface — boxes / cylinders at lat/lng (or country centroid), height ≈ value-mapped, colour from scale or per-entry. Great for population-per-city, GDP-per-country, sales-per-region.

members.name: height
members.description: Min/max bar height in world units (1.0 = globe radius). Default 0.02 → 0.4.

members.name: width
members.description: Bar diameter in world units. Default 0.012.

members.name: animateOnMount
members.description: Animation on mount: 'rise' grows bars from 0 → target height over `mountDurationMs` (default 700). 'none' snaps in.

members.name: id
members.description: Either `id` (resolves to country centroid) OR explicit `position`.

members.name: color
members.description: Optional explicit colour overrides the scale lookup.

members.name: data
members.description: Free-form payload available in events.

ExtrudedDataLayer.name: ExtrudedDataLayer
ExtrudedDataLayer.description: Extruded countries — each country polygon pushed outward along its surface normal at a value-derived height. 3D variant of choropleth. Side walls connect the surface ring to the elevated top.

members.name: height
members.description: Min/max extrusion height in world units. Default 0.005 → 0.18.

members.name: animateOnMount
members.description: Animation on mount: 'rise' grows from 0 → target. 'none' snaps in. Default 'rise', 700ms.

members.name: events
members.type: DataLayerEvents<{ readonly id: string; readonly value?: number }>

HeatmapDataLayer.name: HeatmapDataLayer
HeatmapDataLayer.description:
Volumetric heatmap — many lat/lng samples accumulate into a continuous density field. The density is rendered both as a colour band over the globe AND as a vertical displacement of a high-resolution sphere.

Implementation: density is **pre-baked into an equirectangular texture** (default 2048×1024) so the GPU samples it per-pixel. Vertex shader displaces the surface; fragment shader picks colour from a 1D palette texture built from the layer's `scale`. Pixel-perfect smoothness — no triangulation artifacts even at low subdivisions.

Good for crime density, cell-tower coverage, earthquake aggregations, population pressure, internet usage — anything that feels "continuous".

members.name: radius
members.description: Default angular influence radius (radians) when an entry doesn't specify its own. Default 0.12 (~6.9°).
members.default: angular influence radius (radians) when an entry doesn't specify its own

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Max vertex displacement (world units; 1 = globe radius) at peak density. Default 0. Set to a small value such as 0.04–0.10 for a professional 3D relief; large values quickly dominate the globe.

members.name: subdivisions
members.description: Icosphere subdivision driving the displacement mesh. Colour is pixel-perfect via the shader regardless. Default 6 (≈40k verts). 7 (≈160k) is hero-shot quality; 5 (≈10k) is fine for big-picture.

members.name: kernel
members.description: Kernel shape — see {@link HeatmapKernel}. Default `'gaussian'`.

members.name: textureResolution
members.description: Resolution of the density texture (equirectangular). Higher = sharper detail in tight clusters; costs more bake time + GPU memory. Default 2048×1024 (~8MB). 4096×2048 for hero shots, 1024×512 for live updates.

members.name: blendMode
members.description:
How the heatmap composites with the underlying globe surface.
- `'normal'` (default) — opaque-style alpha blend; vivid, professional. Looks like deck.gl HeatmapLayer / Mapbox heatmaps.
- `'additive'` — adds onto the surface; produces glow / neon look, great for night-style globes and hotspot reveals.

members.name: blurPasses
members.description: Post-bake blur passes applied to the density texture (3×3 box blur, separable). Smooths over pixel-level discontinuities at high subdivisions or low texture resolutions. Default 2. 0 disables.

members.name: normalize
members.description: Density normalisation — see {@link HeatmapNormalize}. Default `'peak'`.

members.name: absoluteMax
members.description: Required when `normalize: 'absolute'`. Density value treated as 1.0.

members.name: threshold
members.description: Cutoff fraction of peak density (0..1). Pixels below this threshold render fully transparent — sharpens the hotspots and reveals the underlying globe in cooler regions. Default 0.

members.name: intensity
members.description: Multiplier on normalised density before the curve. >1 pushes mids toward saturation; <1 dampens. Default 1.

members.name: curve
members.description: Response curve for COLOUR — see {@link HeatmapCurve}. Default `'smoothstep'`.

members.name: displacementCurve
members.description: Response curve for DISPLACEMENT only. Decoupled from `curve` so the 3D shape can read smoothly (bell-like) even when colour uses a sharp curve (cubic) for crisp hotspots. Defaults to whatever `curve` is set to. For pro-grade 3D peaks set this to `'smoothstep'` or `'sqrt'` to avoid plateaus where many density values saturate to 1.

members.name: meshResolution
members.description: Override the displacement mesh subdivision (longitudinal × latitudinal segments). Higher = smoother peaks at zoom-in, costs vertex shader work. Auto-promoted from 256×128 → 1024×512 when `maxHeight > 0` unless explicitly set here. For hero 3D shots try 2048×1024.

members.name: lightDirection
members.description: Light source direction in world space (normalised, doesn't have to sum to 1). Drives the analytical Lambert shading on the displaced surface. Default `[1, 0.6, 0.7]`. Only matters when `maxHeight > 0`.

members.name: shading
members.description: Strength of Lambert shading on the displaced surface. 0 = unlit (flat colour), 1 = full directional shading. Default 0.6 — keeps colour vivid while giving peaks visible volume.

members.name: paletteSteps
members.description: Palette texture resolution — controls colour banding. Default 256. Bump to 512 for very smooth gradients; drop to 16/32 for stepped/topo.

members.name: grid
members.description: Procedural lat/lng grid drawn inside the heatmap shader. Useful for high-density 3D views where the colour field needs surface texture and perspective cues. `false` disables it explicitly.

members.name: contours
members.description: Topographic contour lines drawn from the shaped density field. `false` disables them explicitly.

members.name: rimFade
members.description: Fade width near the visible limb, expressed as radial facing dot range [0..1]. Values around 0.12–0.20 hide exaggerated horizon silhouettes while preserving the centre of the globe. Default 0.

members.name: zoomScaling
members.description: View-dependent relief scaling. This does not rebake density; it only adjusts shader uniforms each frame. `false` disables it explicitly.

members.name: countryDomes
members.description: Rasterize matching `HeatmapDataEntry.id` / `.name` samples inside country polygons as bounded domes. If the active globe kind cannot provide country geometry, or an entry cannot be matched, the layer falls back to the normal radial kernel for that entry.

members.name: animation
members.description: Mount/init animation. `true` enables the default rise (1.2s, `ease-out-cubic`); object form lets you tune duration / easing / stagger / style. Set `false` to mount instantly. Per-entry overrides (`HeatmapDataEntry.animation.delay`) compose with the layer-level `stagger` to drive a per-pixel delay map at bake time.

members.name: id
members.description: Optional country id used by country-aware heatmap modes.

members.name: name
members.description: Optional country name used by country-aware heatmap modes.

members.name: radius
members.description: Per-sample influence radius (rad) override. Falls back to layer radius.

members.name: weight
members.description: Per-sample weight multiplier. Default 1.

members.name: animation
members.description: Per-entry animation override. Only `delay` (relative shift in ms, combined with the layer's `stagger`) and `enabled: false` (skip this entry from the animation entirely) are honoured today; `style`, `easing`, `duration` come from the layer-level config so the GPU LUT stays per-layer. Pass `false` to opt this entry out of animation.

members.name: resolution
members.description: Icosphere subdivision level (0–5). Default 3.

members.name: aggregate
members.description: How multiple samples landing in the same cell combine. See {@link HexBinAggregateMode}. Default 'sum'.

members.name: height
members.description: Min/max cell extrusion in world units (1 = globe radius). Default { min: 0, max: 0.06 }.

members.name: showEmpty
members.description: Render cells with no samples using `scale.noDataColor` or the layer default. Default false.

members.name: opacity
members.description: Layer opacity multiplier. Default 1.

members.name: cellInset
members.description: 0..1 — how much each cell keeps its original footprint after shrinking toward its centroid. `1` means contiguous cells; lower values create larger gaps. Default 0.94 (≈3% gap on each edge).

members.name: cellBorder
members.description: Optional border lines drawn along each cell's edges. Useful for topographic-style maps where the cell boundary itself is informative, or when `cellInset = 1` (no gap) and you still want grid lines.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Pointer-hover highlight overlay. Default disabled.

members.name: animation
members.description: Mount/init animation. Set `false` to mount instantly.

members.name: events
members.description: Pointer hover/click events. `entry` is a `HexBinHoverPayload`; the cellIndex is stable across re-bakes for the same `resolution`.

members.name: value
members.description: Aggregated as `value` — defaults to 1 (so `aggregate: 'count'` works).

members.name: gaugeMax
members.description: For `chartType: 'gauge'` — the value that fills the full 180° arc. Default 100.

members.name: gaugeBackgroundColor
members.description: For `chartType: 'gauge'` — colour of the empty arc behind the fill. Default 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)'.

members.name: valuePreScale
members.description: For `chartType: 'extruded'` — compress per-entry value before the scale-to-height mapping. Power-law data (GDP, CO₂, population) puts 95% of countries near zero height under linear scaling, while USA / China / India tower above. `'sqrt'` (default) gives visible mid-tier heights without flattening the giants; `'log'` compresses harder; `'linear'` preserves raw ratios.

members.name: borderColor
members.description: Per-segment outline colour. When set together with non-zero `borderWidth` (or `borderWidth` omitted), each bar / pie / donut segment gets `LineSegments` along its edges in this colour. Skipped entirely when omitted — no allocation, no draw call.

members.name: borderWidth
members.description: 0..1 outline opacity. Default 0.55. (WebGL caps line thickness at 1px on most browsers; "width" is opacity-driven instead.) Set to 0 to disable borders even if `borderColor` is supplied.

members.name: labels
members.description: HTML label overlay anchored above each chart.

members.name: animation
members.description: Mount/init animation. Reuses {@link HeatmapAnimationConfig}; set `false` to mount instantly.

members.name: segmentStagger
members.description: Extra delay applied per-series within each chart, in ms. With `0` (default) every segment of one chart animates together; with `>0` the series reveal one after another (e.g. stacked bars grow bottom-up, radial spokes sweep clockwise).

members.name: highlight
members.description: Pointer-driven highlight on hover — same idea as hex-bin's. When enabled, the hit bar/segment fades up to `color` opacity (default white tint) while the rest dim a touch.

ChartsDataEntry.name: ChartsDataEntry
ChartsDataEntry.description: Per-location chart data. `id` resolves to a country centroid via the active kind's feature map; `position` overrides that and works for any lat/lng anchor (cities, sensors, custom POIs).

members.name: values
members.description: Per-series values keyed by `ChartSeries.key`. Missing keys are treated as 0 (segment not drawn). Negative values are clamped to 0 — chart geometry assumes non-negative semantics.

members.name: label
members.description: Optional display label, used by future labelling overlay.

members.name: animation
members.description: Per-entry animation override. Same shape as the layer-level `animation` config; today only `delay` (relative shift in ms, combined with the layer's `stagger × index` formula) and `enabled: false` (skip this entry) are honoured. Use to highlight a specific country's chart by giving it a delay of 0 while the rest stagger in.

members.name: data
members.description: Free-form payload available in events.

CinematicQuality.name: CinematicQuality
CinematicQuality.description:
Cinematic kind — realistic/marketing-oriented globe identity. This kind is still driven by the same canonical layers, but adds a richer base stack: physically-lit ocean shell, warm land wash, city-light point data and a subtle surface connection network. Data layers keep the same semantic contracts (`choropleth`, `heatmap`, etc.) and render through the kind's own visual language.

Sentinel reset semantics match the rest of the engine: empty-string colors = use theme defaults; non-positive numeric values where the natural domain is positive = use construction/theme default.

HeatmapKernel.name: HeatmapKernel
HeatmapKernel.description:
Kernel function used to spread each sample's value into a continuous density field. Different kernels give different visual characters:
- `gaussian` — soft, infinite tail. The classical heatmap look.
- `epanechnikov` — bell-curve with a hard edge at the radius. Tight peaks.
- `quartic` — smoother edge than epanechnikov, broader plateau at peak.
- `dome` — rounded crown with a steep wall near the radius cutoff.
- `uniform` — flat disk; binary inside / outside the kernel.

HeatmapNormalize.name: HeatmapNormalize
HeatmapNormalize.description:
How accumulated density gets mapped to the [0, 1] range that drives displacement and color:
- `peak` — divide by the maximum density. Always saturates to 1 at the hottest pixel. Good for relative comparisons.
- `absolute` — caller's `absoluteMax` value is treated as the saturation point. Lets you keep a stable visual reference across data updates.
- `log` — `log1p(d) / log1p(peak)`. Compresses wide-range data so small clusters stay visible next to extreme outliers.

HeatmapCurve.name: HeatmapCurve
HeatmapCurve.description: Curve applied to the normalised density before sampling colour / displacement. Lets you bend the visual response without changing the data: `smoothstep` softens, `cubic` sharpens peaks, `sqrt` brightens mids, `linear` is raw.

HexBinAggregateMode.name: HexBinAggregateMode
HexBinAggregateMode.description:
Hex-bin aggregation — lat/lng point samples are binned into the faces of a subdivided icosphere (visually triangular cells; "hex" is the common name for this kind of geographic binning). Each cell renders as a flat or extruded prism whose colour comes from the aggregated value via `scale` and whose height comes from value→[height.min, max].

Subdivision levels: 0=20 cells · 1=80 · 2=320 · 3=1280 · 4=5120 · 5=20480. Level 3 is the sweet-spot default — fine enough to pick up regional patterns, coarse enough to cluster cleanly even with 1k samples.

ChartType.name: ChartType
ChartType.description:
Chart sub-type rendered at each anchor.
- `'bars-grouped'` — N parallel bars side-by-side
- `'bars-stacked'` — single column with composition segments
- `'pie'` — flat disc segmented by series share
- `'donut'` — pie with hollow centre (`innerRadius`)
- `'radial'` — N bars arranged around a circle, height = value
- `'gauge'` — 180° arc filling proportional to `series[0]` / `gaugeMax`, with a background arc behind. Single-value chart.
- `'sunburst'` — two concentric rings: outer = series segments by share, inner = single ring at half the radius coloured by the sum total mapped through `scale`. Cheap nested overview.
- `'extruded'` — each country's polygon (resolved via entry.id) is raised outward from the globe surface as a 3D prism with walls. Height = sum of series values, colour from the layer scale. The "3D choropleth with charts animation system" — bridges the existing extruded data layer into the charts API + animation library.

ChartSeries.name: ChartSeries
ChartSeries.description: One series of a multi-series chart. `key` indexes into each entry's `values` map; `color` overrides the layer-level `scale` for this series specifically.
